comparison_role: Descriptive one-seed confirmatory frozen-design comparison; no PASS/FAIL survival gate
final_source: Reload best; re-infer full usable Test once; recalibrate/freeze source threshold before LCC
lcc: Full physical training/development/evaluation and pooled Combined; no LCC tuning

r7_gate_ablation.hypothesis: estimate direction and magnitude of the gate-policy contrast without presuming improvement
r7_gate_ablation.metrics: source/LCC AUC,EER,source-frozen APCER/BPCER/ACER,coverage; CASIA evaluation separately
r7_gate_ablation.no_gate_diagnostic_note: harmful_count/fraction=0 indicate disabled harmful-loss counters, not measured absence of margin degradation
r7_gate_ablation.question: R7 harmful-only versus all-selected worst-view CE under the same spectral width
r7_gate_ablation.selection: min source Test-as-Val ACER, source AUC tie-break; warmup excluded
r7_gate_ablation.treatment: harmful gate with H-normalization versus no gate with B-normalization

reference_comparison: Full Test/full LCC scope; differing preprocessing permitted by user
selection: Full official CelebA Test-as-Val at every epoch; C eligible epoch1, P3/R7 epoch1 excluded
train: Entire eligible official CelebA Train, no sampling
training_budget_note: The full CelebA-Spoof training set is approximately 500K samples. Therefore the full-scale training budget uses 12 epochs with milestones [4,8], while preserving the same three-phase SGD schedule structure.
